title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-09-06
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
source: Restored version of Grateful Dead portion of source ID 16608; Lineage given in shnid 16608: Ampex C-90 Master Cassette Soundboard (No Dolby)->DAT->CD->EAC->SHN->CD->EAC->SHN; corrected the speed, and restored the crispness of the recording with a multifilter (spectral filter, two virtual valve simulators for harmonics, channel blender set to mono below 125Hz)using Diamond Cut Forensics 8.5.

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard restoration captures a laid‑back Friend of Mine, but the set feels incomplete and an organ part on It’s All Over Now sounds off‑key.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clear sound and solid restoration work, especially highlighting Jerry Garcia's thick, twangy solo on “Friend of Mine” backed by tasteful keyboards. However, reviewers note that the performance feels a bit unfinished and some renditions fall short of the Dead’s high‑water marks, with an organ that sounds out of key on “It’s All Over Now.”

ai_rating.rationale: Two strong positive comments about the restoration and specific song performance offset by criticism of the show's completeness and a key issue, yielding an overall rating near 4 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Nice sound and solid restoration noted; no major dropouts, though one reviewer questions the organ pitch on a specific track.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert feels somewhat incomplete and the renditions aren't among the year’s best, but it retains a rocking energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His solo on Friend of Mine is described as thick and twangy, standing out positively.
band_member_comments.Keys: Nice keys accompany Jerry on Friend of Mine; organ may be in the wrong key on It’s All Over Now.
